- D-research-missing-03-01-source_1.pdf

If the papers do not answer the question, use 'unanswerable'. Put reasoning, uncertainty, qualifications and citations in explanation and citations, not in answer. Do not shorten an answer by omitting requested parts. For non-claim tasks set verdict to null. Finish with one JSON object exactly in this shape:
{"answer": "<direct answer only>", "explanation": "<reasoning and limitations>", "verdict": <"SUPPORTED", "REFUTED", "NOT ENOUGH EVIDENCE", or null>, "citations": [{"claim": "<supported factual statement>", "paper": "<file name of the paper>", "page": <1-based page>, "quote": "<verbatim text from that page>"}], "confidence": <0..1>}
